dataset.name: Credit Card Fraud Detection (ULB / Worldline)
dataset.source: OpenML dataset 1597, version 1; originally collected/analyzed by Worldline and ULB MLG
dataset.known_scope: anonymized transactions from two days in September 2013; original Amount currency is undocumented; not representative of current payment traffic

split.method: stable chronological ordering by Time; first 70% train, next 15% validation, final 15% test

model.selection_metric: Validation average precision; test split remains untouched
model.calibration: No post-hoc calibration; class-weighted outputs are uncalibrated ranking scores, not calibrated fraud probabilities
model.time_handling: Time is used only to order the split and excluded from model features
model.threshold_selection: relative-cost-minimizing threshold selected on validation only (20:1 false-negative to false-positive weight); illustrative, not an operating policy

test_metrics.latency_scope: 100 warmed in-process single-row predictions; excludes HTTP, serialization, network, and infrastructure

limitations: The dataset covers only two days in 2013 and has anonymized PCA features; it does not establish generalization to current payment systems.
The dataset contains no account identifier, so account-disjoint evaluation is unavailable.
Threshold selection uses illustrative costs on one validation segment; these are not measured operating costs.
One chronological split does not quantify temporal variability; repeat-period validation is needed for stronger claims.
Relative cost weights are illustrative and not measured operating costs; Amount currency is unspecified, so no INR amount or ROI claim is made.
